definitions.explanation: The machine used to process payments in stores, or the checkout area where payments are made. Short for 'register'.

examples.japanese: レジ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
レジ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please line up at the checkout.

examples.japanese: レジ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: There are a lot of people at the checkout.

examples.japanese: レジ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{千|せん}{円|えん}→千円：08980_senen⟧⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}しました→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I handed over a 1000-yen bill at the register.

examples.japanese: ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、レジ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When you're done shopping, please go to the register and pay the clerk.

notes:
レジ is short for ⟦レジスター→レジスター：30462_rejisutaa⟧ (register), borrowed from English. It refers to both the cash register machine and the checkout area in stores.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- レジ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay at the register
- レジ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up at checkout
- レジ⟦{係|がかり}→係：02552_kakari⟧: cashier
- ⟦セルフレジ→セルフレジ：09836_serufureji⟧: self-checkout

SHOPPING VOCABULARY:
- レジ⟦{袋|ぶくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧: shopping bag (plastic bag at checkout)
- ⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧: receipt
- お⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧: bill, check (formal)

USAGE:
Since 2020, Japan charges for レジ⟦{袋|ぶくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧ (plastic bags) at checkout. You may be asked: レジ⟦{袋|ぶくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？(Would you like a bag?)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧: payment, accounting
- ⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧: settlement, payment
